name: David and Goliath
source: Toni Kennerson, school sheet (David and Goliath.docx via /workspace/katas/david-and-goliath.md)
senseiLine: Practice your kata with your instructor.

steps.text: (New Starting Position) Begin at the position of attention. (Hands at sides, feet w/heels together and toes pointed at 45-degree angles)
Raise both hands up, to the inside of the body and outward into double knife hand blocks with palms facing forward (Breaking a choke/shoulder hold)
Step forward w/RF, RH backfist to opponent’s face (kiai/spirit yell). Step forward w/LF, LH downward block, then step forward w/ RF, RH straightforward punch to body
Pivot on the balls of feet, face L w/RF in rear, LL is now forward, LH downward block, then RF step forward, RH straight forward punch

Raise RH fist (across body) to L ear, look over R shoulder then 180- degree turn (“big special turn”) w/RF leading, end facing R w/RF forward, followed by RH downward block (over RL), LF step forward then LF straightforward punch

Step back w/RF into short cat stance, shoulders now facing the front of the school. Step forward w/ LF, LH backfist to opponent’s face, followed by step forward w/ RF, RH straightforward punch followed by LH reverse punch
Pivot on the balls of feet, face L w/RF in rear, LL is now forward. RH reverse inside block then step forward with RF then LH reverse straight forward punch

Hide L fist behind head/raise to L ear, then look over R shoulder then 180- degree turn w/RF leading, end facing R w/RF forward. LH reverse inside block then step forward with LF then RH reverse straight forward punch

Pivot to the rear w/ RF forward, RH backfist to opponent’s face, then step forward w/LF, LH straightforward punch followed by RH reverse straightforward punch to solar plexus, step forward w/RF, LH reverse punch to opponent’s face

**From perspective of facing the rear** Pivot to L w/ LF forward, then LH overhead block, followed by “catching” hands on the R hip, then RF front kick w/ RF landing in front, followed by RH straightforward punch
steps.schoolNote: **R of school=L Pivot: Even though it is the ”R” of the school, it is the student’s ”L” due to the 1st Person point-of-view from facing the rear.

steps.text: **From perspective of facing the rear** Look over R shoulder, then 180- degree turn w/RF leading, end facing R w/RF forward, RH overhead block, followed by “catching” hands on the L hip, then LF front kick w/ LF landing in front, followed by LH straight forward punch
steps.schoolNote: **L of school=R Pivot: Even though it is the ”L” of the school, it is the student’s ”R” due to 1st Person point-of-view from facing the rear.

steps.text: Pivot towards the front of the school, while dragging your LF to your RF: heels together, toes at slight 45-degree angle, while simultaneously bring both arms up, palms up, in a half-circular motion, then complete the circular motion by bringing arms down sharply, palms down, ending w/ hands slightly to the outside of hips (simulation of breaking a double-handed choke hold attempt)

finishNote: Not on the school sheet; Jay confirmed D&G ends with a bow (Oct 24).
